parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.nama_input)
       q.nama_input,
       p.id, p.nama, p.nip, p.pangkat_golongan, p.jabatan
FROM unnest($1::text[]) AS q(nama_input)
LEFT JOIN pegawai p
  ON p.nama ILIKE '%' || q.nama_input || '%'
ORDER BY q.nama_input, similarity(p.nama, q.nama_input) DESC NULLS LAST;

parameters.query:
WITH st AS (
  INSERT INTO surat_tugas
    (kegiatan, tempat, tanggal_mulai, tanggal_selesai, dasar, pembebanan_biaya, pemohon_wa, status, created_at)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3::date, COALESCE($4::date, $3::date), $5, $6, $7::int8, 'menunggu', now())
  RETURNING id
),
sp AS (
  INSERT INTO surat_tugas_petugas (surat_tugas_id, pegawai_id)
  SELECT st.id, x.pegawai_id
  FROM st, jsonb_to_recordset($8::jsonb) AS x(pegawai_id int)
),
lg AS (
  INSERT INTO log_permintaan (waktu, no_wa, jenis_surat, status)
  SELECT now(), $7::int8, 'surat_tugas', 'diajukan'
),
rs AS (
  UPDATE sesi SET stage = NULL, draft_json = NULL, jenis = NULL, updated_at = now()
  WHERE chat_id = $7::int8
)
SELECT id FROM st;

       nis_nisn, nama_orang_tua, alamat, similarity(nama, $1) AS skor
FROM siswa
WHERE nama ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
ORDER BY skor DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT tanggal_mulai, tanggal_selesai, judul, kategori
FROM agenda
WHERE (
  ($3 = '' AND tanggal_mulai <= $2::date AND tanggal_selesai >= $1::date)
  OR
  ($3 <> '' AND judul ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%' AND tanggal_selesai >= CURRENT_DATE)
)
ORDER BY tanggal_mulai ASC
LIMIT 20;
